profile.headline: IT Support Professional and Freelance Web Developer
profile.summary:
Knowledgeable in both the Hardware and Software sides of Computers, as well as
network design and network troubleshooting. Experienced in customer communication and customer care. Substantial involvement in managing and organizing large amounts of information while increasing production throughput. Exceptional at taking in and applying new knowledge. Proven ability to manage multiple projects while meeting challenging deadlines.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer & Digital Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed and currently manage a live Shopify e-commerce storefront (shujaacollective.store) for a social media
content creator brand, handling Printify product integration, catalog management, and storefront configuration.
• Collaborated with the Helm Bots development team on Telegram-based bot and app projects, contributing to frontend/UI
work, QA testing, and project coordination.
• Provide ongoing website maintenance, product updates, and client communication to ensure a seamless and consistent
customer experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Design · Technology Services · Coding Experience

positions.title: IT Engineer
positions.description: Microsoft admin within an MSP environment. Proficient in managing Microsoft environments, including Group Policy administration, security measures, and domain blocking. Skilled in Microsoft Azure integration and cloud resource management. Conducted workstation onboarding across various industries, ensuring optimal functionality. Configured network devices (Datto & Cisco) and implemented security monitoring protocols (Huntress) for enhanced connectivity and threat detection. Expertise in VPN setup, server administration, and managing software subscriptions.

positions.title: Security Professional
positions.locationName: Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · On-site

positions.title: IT Support Specialist
positions.description:
Provided professional end-user support via telephone, email, and web submits, ensuring prompt resolution
of technical issues and excellent customer satisfaction.
Troubleshot and resolved VPN issues to ensure secure remote access for end-users.
Provided support for Adobe tools, Cisco, WebEx, and Microsoft Office / O365.
 Tracked incidents and calls using ServiceNow, entering accurate and timely data into the database.
positions.insights: Skills: Domain Name System (DNS) · Mac · Cisco VPN · Virtual Private Network (VPN) · Ticketing Systems · Cisco Systems Products · Remote Troubleshooting · Cisco Routers · Cisco Meraki · Software Troubleshooting · Communication

positions.title: IT Support, Desktop Specialist • Information Technology
positions.description:
Provided IT and network support for various departments such as call center, engineering, and sales.
Provided troubleshooting and monitoring for the company's server systems.
Maintained Salesforce platform as well as updating company data.
Dealt with administration and designing within the Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Salesforce Marketing Cloud environment
Worked with the web development team as a front end developer
